edge.title: Wrap NorMuonH in MuLoCo outer Nesterov SGD (H=30, lr 0.7, mom 0.5)
edge.summary: Adds a MuLoCo-style outer optimizer (Algorithm 1 with one worker, K=1) around the unchanged NorMuonH + AdamW inner loop: every 30 inner steps the displacement Δ = θ_snapshot − θ of every parameter is treated as a pseudo-gradient and an outer Nesterov-SGD step is taken from the snapshot (u ← 0.5u + 0.7Δ; θ ← θ_snapshot − 0.5u − 0.7Δ). This extrapolates past the inner endpoint — 1.05Δ at the first sync and up to ≈1.4Δ once momentum builds for aligned Δ — a lookahead-style acceleration. The runs set TRAIN_STEPS=3210 (exactly 107 syncs, the last one right before the final eval) and OUTER_LR=0.7 via env vars, with #8's schedules and no early stop. The outer step is not re-projected onto the hyperball, so hidden-matrix norms are only fixed between syncs.

changes.label: MuLoCo outer Nesterov wrapper
changes.detail: NesterovOuterOptimizer(list(model.parameters())) snapshots all params; maybe_outer_step() after each inner step runs _outer_step every SYNC_INTERVAL = 30 steps: delta = snapshot − p; u = mom·u + olr·delta; p = snapshot − mom·u − olr·delta; then re-snapshot.

changes.label: Outer hparams via env vars
changes.detail: OUTER_LR (code default 0.5; all runs 0.7), OUTER_MOMENTUM 0.5, SYNC_INTERVAL 30, USE_OUTER_OPTIMIZER on by default; logs print 'olr=0.7 omom=0.5 H=30 train_steps=3210'.

changes.label: Steps 3275→3210, no early stop
changes.detail: train_steps = int(TRAIN_STEPS) (code default 3240 = 108·30; runs 3210 = 107·30); the claim is the final-step eval, whereas #8 claimed step 3250 of 3275.

changes.label: Hyperball norms move at syncs
changes.detail: _outer_step overwrites p.data with no renormalization, so a NorMuonH matrix's Frobenius norm can change at each sync; subsequent scale_invariant_update_ calls then preserve the new norm.

changes.label: Env plumbing and logging
changes.detail: Env-var parsing, an ENABLED/DISABLED print, and a trailing newline; NorMuonH, init, aux AdamW and set_hparams are byte-identical to #8.

edge.parent_check: consistent — declared parent #8 is also the nearest code (70 changed lines, all additive).
edge.noise: Env-var plumbing, the ENABLED/DISABLED print and a trailing newline; the optimizer, init and schedule code are unchanged from #8.

mechanisms.name: MuLoCo outer Nesterov SGD (K=1)
mechanisms.explain: NesterovOuterOptimizer stores a snapshot and an outer momentum buffer u for every parameter. After every 30th inner step it forms the pseudo-gradient Δ = snapshot − θ, sets u ← 0.5u + 0.7Δ and resets θ ← snapshot − 0.5u − 0.7Δ (Nesterov form), then re-snapshots. With a single worker this is a periodic momentum extrapolation of the inner trajectory (1.05Δ at the first sync, ≈1.4Δ in steady state for aligned Δ), applied to hidden and AdamW parameters alike.

caveats: Code defaults (TRAIN_STEPS=3240, OUTER_LR=0.5) are not what ran: all 10 logs print 'MuLoCo outer optimizer ENABLED: olr=0.7 omom=0.5 H=30 train_steps=3210', matching the table, so hparams list the run values. The size of the hidden-norm drift from un-projected outer steps is not measured here; extrapolating past a chord of the sphere tends to push norms outward.
